assessment_objectives.objective: a documented transition plan exists for applicable third-party relationships that defines the activities necessary to support an orderly cessation and transition of third-party services.
the transition plan assigns responsibility for each transition activity to the organization, the outgoing third-party and/or the replacement service provider.
the transition plan identifies the dependencies (e.g., data, interfaces, licenses, personnel and other third-parties) that affect the cessation and transition of third-party services.
the transition plan defines milestones and timelines for the cessation and transition of third-party services, including any contractual notice and transition assistance periods.
progress against transition plan milestones is tracked and deviations are escalated to accountable personnel.
